additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: AW: ID0395100-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N8 160355367] Charging failed CRM:00579001357
additional_info.body:
Hi Stefan,
We have checked the logs for last one month, we found that there were no logs generated between Dec 23rd to Jan 7th, Was the charger shut off during the period?
Secondly, we found 3-4 charging sessions performed since 7th without any issue.
Outlets were going outoforder multiple times but for a second only. Within second it turned back to ready state.
We will monitor the charger for next 24 hours again, and would you request you to please perform the charging session, if the issue occur again let us know we will ask our service team to visit the site and investigate the issue further.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: Analysis
additional_info.body:
Outlets were going outoforder due to Polling coap error, but get restored within same second.
3-4 charging sessions perfromed on Jan 7th.
Don't see any sessions after then.
On Jan 13th around 2:52AM, outlets went outoforder without any error and didn't came back to ready until I rebooted the charger around 14:00.
Asked the customer to perform more charging sessions and monitor the charger, if issue reoccurs please check if there was any error due to which outlets went outoforder.
